newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chiyoda, Daewoo Corp win 12 bln yen KEPCO tender.
newsitem.headline: Chiyoda, Daewoo Corp win 12 bln yen KEPCO tender.

text.p: Chiyoda Corp said on Monday that it and South Korea's Daewoo Corp had been awarded a 12 billion yen contract by Korea Electric Power Co (KEPCO) for a desulphurisation plant.

A Chiyoda spokesman said the company's role was mainly to provide the technology and design for the flue gas desulphurisation (FGD) plant while Daewoo would perform the actual construction and installation.
The firms will provide three FGD plants to KEPCO for its oil thermal power plant in Ulsan, about 50 km north of Pusan, Chiyoda said in a statement.
FGD plants serve to remove sulphur from gas emitted from power plant boilers, the spokesman said.
The FGD plants are due to begin commercial operations between October and December 1998, Chiyoda said.
It said that the project was one of the largest ever to have been awarded to Chiyoda.
